title: 第301章 吃早饭第300章 再寻机会
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
清冷的天光、微凉的晨风、暖融融的烟火、错落的灯火、细碎的人声，冷暖交织，动静相宜，把冬日清晨的市井烟火衬得格外鲜活动人。
杨欢始终揽着席一悠的腰身，掌心温热稳固，将她牢牢护在身侧，替她挡住往来人流与微凉寒风。两人并肩缓步前行，步履悠闲松弛，不疾不徐，在热闹又温柔的市井烟火里，慢慢朝着席府的方向走去。
行至巷口一处人气最旺的街边早点摊，阵阵浓香扑面而来，暖胃又暖心。两人对视一眼，皆是会意，顺势驻足停下。
晨寒侵体，周身微凉，恰好可以吃些热乎早点，驱散一身凉意。
摊前的桌椅简单朴素，擦拭得干净整洁，临街避风，恰好能挡住晨间微凉的穿堂风。
摊主待人热忱利落，手脚麻利地收拾着台面。二人择了这处绝佳的避风空位落座，肩并肩轻轻靠着，身形挨得极近，没有刻意贴合，却处处是浑然天成的亲昵。
点单时两人低声附和，默契十足，选了几份最暖胃的晨间吃食：熬得软糯绵密的小米粥、外酥里软的椒盐烙饼、皮薄馅足的鲜香肉包，皆是市井最朴实暖胃的滋味。
不过片刻，热气腾腾的早点尽数上桌。白白的袅袅白雾盘旋升起，裹挟着浓郁的米面香、肉香，温柔驱散了周身残留的晨寒，暖意扑面而来。温热的烟火气笼罩着小小的桌台，将外界清冷的天光、微凉的寒风尽数隔绝在外，方寸小桌间，只剩两人松弛慵懒的温柔氛围。
杨欢坐姿松弛随意，背脊轻轻靠着椅背，一只手臂依旧习惯性虚揽在席一悠身侧，掌心始终带着温存的暖意。他抬手拿起温热的白瓷勺，没有自顾自用食，先舀了一勺熬得绵密软糯、温度刚好的小米粥，侧身递到席一悠唇边。
晨光落在他眉眼间，褪去了深夜的燥热克制，只剩晨间独有的慵懒温和，眼底藏着浅浅的纵容笑意，静静看着她。
席一悠戴着素色面纱，只露一双澄澈灵动的眼眸，眼尾微微上挑，自带浑然天成的媚态。见他这般细致投喂，她眼底笑意更浓，眸底水光潋滟，温顺微微仰头，张口衔住勺中温热的粥米。唇瓣隔着薄勺轻轻贴合，软糯咽下，细微的动作慵懒又娇媚。
她没有急着低头，反而就着贴近的距离，微微侧头，温热的气息轻轻扫过杨欢的耳廓，压着极轻的气音，软乎乎打趣：“杨道长倒是细心，昨夜熬了大半宿，如今倒是学会贴心伺候人了……”话音软糯细碎，带着晨气未散的慵懒沙哑，轻飘飘落在耳畔，痒得人心尖微颤。
杨欢低低一笑，胸腔震出浅浅的闷响，温热的呼吸轻轻拂过她的发顶。他收回勺子，顺手捏了块酥脆的烙饼，指尖轻轻摩挲着温热的饼边，姿态散漫松弛，侧头看向她，低声回怼：“方才是谁，在一边偷偷笑我？”
这话直指清晨她偷笑的模样，带着几分纵容的调侃，不重不轻，刚好撩得人心头发痒。
席一悠脸颊微热，却半点不怯，反而愈发娇俏放肆。
她微微倾身，肩头轻轻蹭过杨欢的臂膀，柔软的衣料相贴摩挲，带出细碎暧昧的触感。
她抬手，纤细微凉的指尖没有碰吃食，反而轻轻落在杨欢握着勺子的手背上，指腹细细蹭过他温热紧实的肌理，动作轻缓、暧昧，不带半分刻意，却处处撩人。
指尖微凉，掌心滚烫，温差相触，格外清晰。
“我那是好笑吗？我那是心疼你。”她眼眸弯弯，眼底狡黠与温柔交织，语气软糯狡辩，“好好的一桩美事，偏偏被意外打断，换谁都憋屈。我不笑，难道还能替你委屈落泪不成？”
说着，她指尖顺势轻轻勾了勾他的指节，力道极轻，似撩非撩，转瞬便收回手，乖乖拿起桌上的肉包，小口轻咬。

垂眸吃食的模样温顺乖巧，可耳尖微微泛热，眼尾含春，藏不住满心的旖旎戏谑，媚态丛生。
杨欢任由她肆意撩拨，掌心残留着她指尖的微凉触感，心尖微微发痒。
他看着她垂首吃食的娇俏模样，面纱遮面，只露眉眼，一颦一动皆风情暗藏，心底的温柔与纵容愈发浓烈。
他不再打趣，安静陪着她用食，时不时抬手投喂一勺热粥、一块酥饼，动作温柔细致，节奏缓慢松弛。
桌外是市井喧闹，人来人往、语声细碎、烟火灼灼；桌内是二人私语，眉眼流转、肢体轻蹭、情愫暗涌。
外界的热闹半点侵入不了这方寸温柔小境，冷暖交织，动静相宜，暧昧的氛围松弛又绵长，不浓烈逼仄，却缠人入骨。
两人慢条斯理用完早饭，腹中温热妥帖，四肢百骸的微凉尽数被驱散，浑身筋骨都透着松弛慵懒的暖意。
席一悠抬手，随意理了理鬓边散乱的碎发，指尖轻轻拂过耳侧系带，将面纱拢得规整服帖，遮住大半娇容，只余下一双潋滟含春的眼眸，在渐亮的天光里愈发灵动勾人。
杨欢顺势起身，身姿挺拔松弛，抬手简单整理了一番衣衫褶皱，褪去了晨间久坐的慵懒颓态，依旧温润出尘。
他迈步上前，走到摊前轻声结账，举止从容淡然，没有半分拖沓。
待账目结清，他回身抬手，自然而然再度揽住席一悠纤细柔韧的腰身。
掌心温热稳妥，轻轻贴合着她腰间柔软的衣料，力道温柔克制，不逾矩却足够亲昵，是两人之间早已默契入骨的分寸。
席一悠身子微侧，下意识轻轻往他怀里靠了半分，肩头蹭过他的臂膀，动作慵懒娇媚，带着全然放松的信赖。
两人并肩转身，缓步离开喧闹的早点摊，顺着愈发澄澈的天光，朝着席府的方向徐徐前行。
不过片刻光景，天色已然彻底大亮。
破晓后的日光清透柔和，褪去了晨间的薄雾朦胧，澄澈地铺洒在整条长街之上。
冬日的日光不烈不燥，暖意浅浅，刚好压下凌晨的刺骨寒凉，却又留着几分隆冬独有的清冷通透，冷暖相宜，氛围感十足。
content_en:
The cool skylight, the cool morning breeze, the warm fireworks, the scattered lights, the faint voices, the interweaving of cold and warm, and the appropriate movement and stillness make the street fireworks in the winter morning particularly vivid and lively.
Yang Huan always held Xi Yiyou's waist, his palms warm and firm, keeping her firmly by his side, blocking her from the flow of people and the cold wind. The two walked slowly side by side, walking leisurely and relaxedly, neither fast nor slow, slowly walking towards the direction of Xi's mansion amidst the lively and gentle fireworks of the market.
Walking to one of the most popular street breakfast stalls at the entrance of the alley, a strong aroma hits your face, warming your stomach and heart. The two looked at each other, understanding, and stopped.
The morning cold invades the body and the whole body is slightly cool. It is just right to eat some hot breakfast to dispel the coldness.
The tables and chairs in front of the stall are simple and plain, wiped clean and tidy, facing the street and sheltered from the wind, just enough to block the cool morning draft.
The stall owner is warm and courteous, and cleans up the table with quick hands and feet. The two chose this excellent sheltered spot to sit down, leaning side by side, their bodies very close to each other, not deliberately close to each other, but full of natural intimacy.
When ordering, the two of them whispered in agreement and had a perfect understanding. They chose some of the most stomach-warming morning foods: soft and glutinous millet porridge, pretzel pancakes that are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and fresh and fragrant meat buns with thin skin and generous fillings. They are all the most simple and stomach-warming tastes in the market.
In just a moment, the steaming hot breakfast was all on the table. White curls of white mist swirled up, carrying the rich aroma of rice noodles and meat, gently dispelling the remaining morning cold all over the body, and bringing warmth to the face. The warm smoke from fireworks enveloped the small table, blocking out the cold skylight and cool wind from the outside world. Between the small table, only the gentle atmosphere of relaxation and laziness remained between the two of them.
Yang Huan sat in a relaxed and casual posture, with her back lightly leaning against the back of the chair. One arm was still wrapped around Xi Yiyou's side as usual, with a gentle warmth in her palm. He raised his hand and picked up the warm white porcelain spoon. Instead of eating by himself, he first scooped up a spoonful of millet porridge that was thick, soft, glutinous and just the right temperature, and handed it to Xi Yiyou's lips.
The morning light fell between his brows and eyes, fading away the heat and restraint of the late night, leaving only the lazy gentleness unique to the morning. He looked at her quietly with a shallow indulgent smile hidden in his eyes.
Xi Yiyou wore a plain veil, revealing only a pair of clear and lively eyes, with the ends of her eyes slightly raised, giving her a naturally charming look. Seeing him feeding her so meticulously, the smile in her eyes became even stronger, her eyes were watery, she raised her head meekly, and opened her mouth to hold the warm porridge and rice in the spoon. The lips gently pressed together through the thin spoon, and the soft and glutinous food was swallowed. The subtle movements were lazy and coquettish.
She did not lower her head in a hurry. Instead, she tilted her head slightly at the close distance. Her warm breath gently swept across Yang Huan's ear. She suppressed the very light breath and joked softly: "Taoist Master Yang is very attentive. He stayed up most of the night last night, but now he has learned to be considerate and considerate..." The words were soft and fine, with the lazy hoarseness of the morning breath, floating lightly on the ear, making the heart tremble with itch.
Yang Huan smiled lowly, her chest made a shallow muffled sound, and her warm breath gently brushed the top of her hair. He took back his spoon, pinched a piece of crispy pancake, and gently rubbed the edge of the warm pancake with his fingertips. He looked at her sideways and whispered back: "Who was secretly laughing at me?"
These words pointed directly at the way she snickered in the early morning, with a bit of indulgent teasing, neither serious nor light, just enough to make people's hearts itch.
Xi Yiyou's cheeks were slightly warm, but he was not timid at all. Instead, he became more charming and unrestrained.
She leaned forward slightly, her shoulder gently brushing against Yang Huan's arm. The soft fabrics rubbed against each other, bringing out a delicate and ambiguous touch.
She raised her hand, and her slender and cool fingertips did not touch the food. Instead, they gently landed on the back of Yang Huan's hand holding the spoon. Her fingertips rubbed against his warm and tight texture. Her movements were slow and ambiguous, not deliberate at all, but alluring.
The fingertips are slightly cool, the palms are hot, the temperature difference touches each other, and it feels particularly refreshing.Clear.
"Am I being funny? I feel sorry for you." Her eyes were crooked, cunning and tenderness intertwined in her eyes, and her tone was soft and quibbling, "It was a beautiful thing, but it was interrupted by an accident. It would be aggrieved for anyone else. If I don't laugh, how can I shed tears for you?"
As she said that, she gently hooked his knuckles with her fingertips, the force was very light, it seemed like teasing but not teasing. She retracted her hand in a flash, obediently picked up the meat bun on the table, and took a small bite.
He looks docile and well-behaved as he eats with his eyes lowered, but the tips of his ears are slightly warm, and the tail of his eyes is full of spring, and he can't hide his charming, playful, and charming look.
Yang Huan allowed her to tease him arbitrarily, the cool touch of her fingertips still lingering on his palms, and the tip of his heart felt slightly itchy.
He looked at her charming way of eating with her head lowered, her face covered by a veil, only her eyebrows exposed, her every move and frown revealed a hidden charm, and the tenderness and indulgence in his heart grew stronger.
He stopped joking and ate quietly with her. From time to time he would raise his hand to feed her a spoonful of hot porridge or a piece of shortbread. His movements were gentle and meticulous, and his rhythm was slow and relaxed.
Outside the table, there is the bustle of the market, with people coming and going, whispers, and fireworks. Inside the table, there are two people whispering, with their eyebrows and eyes flowing, their bodies touching each other, and their feelings surging.
The excitement of the outside world cannot intrude into this small and gentle place at all. Warm and cold are intertwined, movement and stillness are appropriate, and the ambiguous atmosphere is relaxed and long, not strong and cramped, but entangling to the bones.
The two of them finished breakfast slowly, their stomachs felt warm and comfortable, the slight chill in their limbs and bones was driven away, and their muscles and bones were filled with a relaxing and lazy warmth.
Xi Yiyou raised his hand and smoothed away the scattered hair on his temples. His fingertips gently brushed the laces on the side of his ears, and he pulled the veil neatly and snugly, covering most of his charming face, leaving only a pair of sparkling spring eyes, which became more and more lively and attractive in the brightening sky.
Yang Huan stood up according to the situation, his posture was straight and relaxed, and he raised his hands to simply straighten the folds of his clothes. He lost the lazy and decadent attitude of sitting for a long time in the morning and was still warm and fresh.
He stepped forward, walked to the stall, and paid the bill quietly. His behavior was calm and indifferent, without any delay.
After the account was settled, he turned around and raised his hand, naturally wrapping his arms around Xi Yiyou's slender waist again.
The palm of his hand was warm and steady, gently touching the soft fabric of her waist. The force was gentle and restrained, not overstepping the bounds but intimate enough. This was a tacit understanding between the two of them.
Xi Yiyou turned slightly to his side, subconsciously leaning half into his arms, rubbing her shoulder against his arm, her movements were lazy and coquettish, with a completely relaxed trust.
The two of them turned side by side, slowly left the noisy breakfast stall, and walked slowly in the direction of Xi Mansion under the increasingly clear skylight.
In just a few moments, the sky was completely bright.
The sunlight after dawn is clear and soft, fading away from the hazy morning mist, and spreading over the entire long street with clarity.
The sunlight in winter is neither strong nor dry, and the warmth is shallow. It just suppresses the biting cold in the early morning, but it still retains a bit of the unique coolness and transparency of mid-winter, with a suitable balance of cold and warm, and a full sense of atmosphere.
